decisions.title: Allow Herdr 1
decisions.decision: Herdr 1 is an allowed runtime alongside Herdr Core. Preserve working native UX instead of requiring a Core-only startup or deleting the Herdr 1 backend. D55 is superseded. D24, D37, D48 and D56 apply to Core routes; existing Herdr 1 startup and connectors may serve Herdr 1 routes. Retain exact runtime targets and session ownership. This does not restore excluded features, authorize runtime installation/update or imply untested parity.
decisions.source: Doctor Biz, 2026-11-09: allow herdr 1.

decisions.title: Credit both upstream teams
decisions.decision: The Spaceport About view must explicitly reference the Herdr team and the Sheprd team. Label upstream links as credits, retain required copyright/license notices and avoid implying endorsement.
decisions.source: Doctor Biz, 2026-11-09: refactor About and reference the Herdr team and the Sheprd team.

decisions.title: Remove the inherited custom updater
decisions.decision: Delete the inherited custom Rust updater and its update/install/restart machinery. Spaceport updates remain a required release capability; this is a replacement transition, not removal of SP-023. Support macOS, Windows, Linux and package-manager installation routes. Sparkle and other platform mechanisms were discussed but no replacement library, Homebrew update-ownership policy, signing identity, release endpoint or publication was approved by this deletion instruction. Preserve release-build refusal while independent identity and update routes remain unverified.
decisions.source: Doctor Biz, 2026-11-09: after discussing cross-platform updates and identifying the current custom Rust updater, "let's nuke it".

decisions.title: macOS signed preview workflow
decisions.decision: Implement a macOS-only build-and-sign/notarize artifact workflow using 2389 Research signing credentials and bundle ID ai.2389.spaceport. Windows signing is deferred for this work, not removed from the eventual desktop scope. D64 extends this route to tag-triggered GitHub prereleases. App installation, credential upload, automatic updater and general production release enablement remain separate from this decision. Retain the release refusal and distinguish ordinary development builds from signed previews.
decisions.source: Doctor Biz, 2026-11-09: provided the local 2389 Apple certificate directory, requested updating the workflow without Windows for now, and selected ai.2389.spaceport.

decisions.title: Tag-triggered macOS preview releases
decisions.decision: Extend the macOS preview workflow to build, sign, notarize and publish a DMG plus checksum to a GitHub prerelease when harperreed pushes vYYYYMMDD.COUNTER to 2389-research/spaceport (repository moved under D66). Require the exact tagged commit to belong to main and pass full active-platform main CI under D66. Keep signing credentials in a protected signing job; grant release write access only to publication. Preserve manual artifact-only runs, immutable version reservations and the broader production release refusal. Doctor Biz's follow-up instruction to push and make it work authorizes main integration, hosted environment setup, credential upload and the first verified tagged preview; keep private signing inputs outside Git.
decisions.source: Doctor Biz, 2026-11-10: yes. let's make the tag triggered workflow; then ok. let's gooo and push and make it work dude.

decisions.title: Sparkle updates for macOS previews
decisions.decision: Use pinned Sparkle 2.10.1 for installed macOS previews, with native Check for Updates UI, consent for automatic checks and automatic installation off by default. Keep development/worktree builds excluded. Embed and sign the framework inside the existing ai.2389.spaceport bundle for Team HD9NM9NSMK. Use a separate Spaceport Ed25519 key outside Git/Cargo and in the protected macos-preview environment; require signed feeds without timed recovery (SUSignedFeedFailureExpirationInterval=0) and pre-extraction archive verification. Publish the signed preview feed as the fixed macos-preview-feed GitHub release asset only after the immutable dated release passes verification. Enforce exact Spaceport app/Team identity in packaging, signing and publication. Sparkle permits trusted publisher key and app identity rotation; do not claim its runtime enforces an unconditional old app ID match. Preserve normal GUI quit/detach and never change Herdr/Core lifecycle. Qualify with isolated real signed update/relaunch fixtures and negative trust/rollback cases. Carry implementation through full source CI and a fresh signed release. Other platform/package routes and overall T12 gates remain open.
decisions.source: Doctor Biz, 2026-11-10: lets add sparkle; approved the proposed macOS preview design, separate protected signing key/feed, native fixtures and signed-release delivery.

decisions.title: Move Spaceport to 2389 Research and pause Windows builds
decisions.decision: Transfer the existing public Spaceport repository from harperreed to 2389-research, retaining its history, releases, PRs and protected signing environment. Update active application, release and signed-feed URLs to 2389-research/spaceport while keeping harperreed as the trusted release actor and preserving bundle identity, signing Team and Sparkle keys. Temporarily skip Spaceport's Windows check, native and packaging CI jobs until Kata h8g5 resolves the native performance failure. The aggregate and macOS preview release gates must require all remaining macOS/Linux jobs and the explicit Windows skipped state. This pause does not pass Windows acceptance, change its performance budget or remove Windows from eventual product scope. Qualify the repaired main commit and publish a fresh immutable macOS preview version.
decisions.source: Doctor Biz, 2026-11-11: fix our dead build and tag a new release; disable Windows builds until we fix performance; move this from harperreed to 2389-research.

This supersedes D50's profile/avatar retention only.
